# Language regression inputs

These source files preserve the output and diagnostic contracts formerly exercised
through the public examples. They are test inputs, not the language learning path.
`tests/native_core_test.ml` checks the normal programs, file behavior, and `errors/`.
The stdlib and optimization integration tests also use `key_values.xen` and
`opt_fusion.xen`. `opt_loops.xen` remains a benchmark workload.

User examples live in `examples/`; language documentation starts at `docs/README.md`.
